slot_scores.name: missing_profit_maximization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to maximize total weekly profit, or is it to minimize total weekly cost while meeting the stated minimum profit and minimum Type A production requirements?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked what the objective should be and offered profit maximization as an option.

slot_scores.name: missing_idle_time_minimization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the process cost (12, 8, 10 yuan/hour) applied to the actual hours used for each process, or is it applied to the full weekly capacity regardless of usage?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched the related issue of used versus unused capacity and process cost, but never asked whether idle time should be minimized as a secondary objective weighted by process costs.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The only objective is to maximize profit; idle-time minimization of manufacturing, assembly, and inspection is not part of the optimization model.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether idle time should be minimized or weighted by process cost. Turn 9 only clarified the cost basis and did not confirm the missing idle-time objective.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P0 profit objective but entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 idle-time minimization objective remained unasked and unconfirmed.

summary: The agent successfully recovered the core profit-maximization objective, but it missed the secondary idle-time minimization objective and stopped with that P1 hidden slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
